title: Reimagining Synthetic Tabular Data Generation through Data-Centric AI: A Comprehensive Benchmark
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion. The findings focus on the technical performance of synthetic data generation methods, concluding that statistical fidelity alone is insufficient to evaluate data utility and that data-centric AI techniques can improve the quality of synthetic data.
